unit.why: This division is a liturgical and kabbalistic guide to study for the yahrzeit and the year of mourning. It lists which mishnayot to study, gives kavvanot and prayers, and quotes the Ruzhin rebbe, Komarno and the Hida, but it tells no story.
unit.boundary_note: Starts the new section אות י (yahrzeit). The trailing 'מענין יצה״ר' is the heading of the next division.
